post.caption: A hotel vending machine dispensed gold. In 2010, the Emirates Palace hotel in Abu Dhabi installed a machine called Gold To Go, built by a German company. It sold 24 karat gold bars in sizes from 1 to 10 grams, and gold coins like the Krugerrand and the Maple Leaf. The hotel wanted to be the first to offer this golden service. It took dirham notes, and every item carried a money back guarantee. The hotel also planned souvenir bars engraved with its logo. The machine itself was plated in 24 karat gold.
